oracle.method: each atom's value is an identified functional of the enumerated count table (edge g-formula, front-door, adjustment, unadjusted or covariate-adjusted mediation functional, exact parent regressions for the linear Dag atoms) in exact rational arithmetic; the graph-posterior value is the hand-weighted mean over the atoms that identify the query, the unidentified mass is the weight of the atoms that do not, and a class atom's value is the mean of its identified completions
asserted_outputs: posteriors.*.*.mixture (value, unidentified_mass, set) and the per-atom values
oracle.independence_basis: The generator evaluates the edge g-formula, front-door, adjustment, unadjusted and covariate-adjusted mediation functionals from the declared cell counts in exact rational arithmetic, solves the Dag atoms' parent regressions by exact normal equations on a crossed design, and weights the atoms by hand; it imports no Antecedent code and no statistics package. The shared object is the count tables.
oracle.historical_exposure: Written for this fixture; the count tables are copied from the single-graph path-specific, interventional-distribution and mediation fixtures, whose own references derive the observed law by enumerating structural noise cells.

reference_review.scope: Identified functionals of enumerated count tables, their posterior-weighted mixture, unidentified mass and identified-set hull for path-specific, interventional-distribution and mediation queries over atoms of five graph kinds.
reference_review.independence_basis: The generator evaluates the edge g-formula, front-door, adjustment, unadjusted and covariate-adjusted mediation functionals from the declared cell counts in exact rational arithmetic, solves the Dag atoms' parent regressions by exact normal equations on a crossed design, and weights the atoms by hand; it imports no Antecedent code and no statistics package. The shared object is the count tables.
reference_review.historical_exposure: Written for this fixture; the count tables are copied from the single-graph path-specific, interventional-distribution and mediation fixtures, whose own references derive the observed law by enumerating structural noise cells.
reference_review.redistribution: Repository-authored MIT OR Apache-2.0 generator and deterministic inputs. Python standard library only, in an isolated locked script environment, outside the product and ordinary CI; no upstream source is stored.
reference_review.limitations: The atoms of one posterior are tied to one data table, so atoms that are consistent with the data agree wherever their identifying formulas coincide and the posteriors choose graphs that differ in what they adjust. An ADMG atom cannot hold a bow. The Dag mediation table is a noise-free crossed design. No uncertainty or calibration.
